gen-gf-baumans-gf-red-hat-text: Commanding up top, Baumans draws every stroke at a single thickness, while Red Hat Text keeps curvy, unclamped letters underneath. Paragraphs of it would feel modern and approachable, never stiff.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-reddit-sans: Reddit Sans opens the e with a wide gap at the terminal and keeps its thickness constant in every direction, beneath Baumans. Baumans does the shouting; the text just keeps talking.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-rethink-sans: Rethink Sans keeps its openings generous at every weight and draws each stroke uniformly, giving a modern, approachable build. Rethink Sans carries the reading while Baumans makes the entrance.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-roboto-flex: A crescent-wrench c, opened wide, gives Baumans its commanding look, every stroke held to a single thickness from top to bottom. Roboto Flex joins in with a wide slot between the c's two ends.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-rosario: Rosario is contemporary and approachable, with c ends that never turn inward, sitting under the crescent-wrench c of Baumans. Rosario gives the commanding Baumans a soft, humming place to land.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-ruluko: Ruluko is clean and approachable sans-serif with broad open counters. Beside Baumans and its constant top-to-baseline stroke, a longer text in it would move along smoothly, never snagging.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-sansation: Approachable and neutral, Sansation turns its curves in without any ink pooling, while Baumans holds every stroke to a single thickness. Sansation holds up well a few sizes below Baumans.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-sarabun: Clean and approachable, Sarabun gives every bowl a wide channel, a quiet counterpart to the thick diagonals of Baumans. Baumans makes the announcement and Sarabun carries on from there.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-sarala: A crescent-wrench c opened wide gives Baumans its commanding presence, every stroke uniform in thickness from top to bottom. Sarala handles the text, its thickness like neon glass.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Wide-jawed swagger: Baumans bends a wrench-shaped c and lets its diagonals match the horizontals. Sawarabi Gothic, with open jaws on every curve, would read contemporary and smooth across a long text.
